notes.title: Aliens versus Predator Classic 2000 Update Released
notes.content:
Updates to Aliens versus Predator Classic 2000 have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client is restarted. The major changes include:

Aliens versus Predator Classic 2000
  • Added game type to the game description on the "Join Game" menu
  • Multiplayer is no longer in beta
